text: Credential CRD_002236 was revoked on 2025-10-21, and its holder billed the first post-revocation claim just 23 days later — followed by 57 claims in total after the revocation date. Individually, a rostered doctor with a lapsed credential is common in this economy; what moves this to the top of the queue is the volume: 57 claims is roughly double the highest post-revocation count any ordinarily-rostered revoked doctor reaches here, and it continued at full pace rather than winding down. The recency matters too — this is not an old administrative tail, the revocation is current. An alternative reading is that the doctor holds a second valid credential the graph has under a different identity, which the shared-licence checks did not surface. Next step: confirm with the issuing body whether any parallel authorisation exists, and hold the 57 claims for manual review in the meantime.
